title: Cloud Migration Prerequisites for Dynamics GP

facts.text: Destination requires Business Central online tenant with at least one SUPER user.
Install Intelligent Cloud Base, Dynamics GP Intelligent Cloud, and history SmartLists apps.
GP migration currently supported only in US, Canada, UK, and Australia markets.
Source requires Dynamics GP 2015 or later on SQL Server 2016 SP1 or later.
SQL database compatibility level must be 130 or higher with TCP/IP enabled.
SQL authentication login needs sysadmin role at server level and db_owner role at database level.
Self-hosted integration runtime machine must meet Azure Data Factory prerequisites.
